evals.prompt: We ran the full LLM audit and have a dozen findings across different Areas - can you turn this into one remediation plan we can actually work through?
evals.expected_output: Routes each finding to the right propose-llm-* child (some to controls, some to prompt-changes, some to both), runs them, and merges into one plan prioritized by severity and effort-vs-impact, split into must-fix vs fast-follow.

evals.prompt: An external pentest firm gave us a PDF with a few AI-related findings, not from your audit skills - can you still build a remediation plan from those?
evals.expected_output: Normalizes the external findings into the shared finding format (asking for missing severity/location info rather than guessing), then routes and merges them the same way as audit-llm-* output.
